*Revisiting cultural omnivorousness through symbolic boundaries in musical tastes*

Using data from 14,524 people in Spain, we find that even broad musical tastes coexist with clear exclusions between genres.

Rather than a dominant omnivorous pattern, we find different taste structures characterized by varying degrees of breadth, specialization and exclusion.
